text.description_html:
Brass Accents P3221/C02-P7980-HOLE, Fleur De Lis Pull Plate with Colonial Pull with Cut-Out for Mortise Cylinder

This gorgeous Fleur De Lis Pull Plate with Colonial Pull with Hole features the popular Fleur de Lis design at both ends, as well as patterned edges with incredible detail. The Fleur De Lis Pull Plate with Colonial Pull has a Cut-Out for a Mortise Cylinder.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available: Fleur De Lis Push Plate

Specifications for Brass Accents P3221/C02-P7980-Hole Decorative Fleur De Lis Pull Plate with Cut-Out:

  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Height: 18"
  • Pull Handle Length: 7"
  • Center of Plate to Center of Cylinder Hole: 5-5/8"
  • Material: Solid Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
